name: Emporio.Ivankov
title: Let the miracle unfold as you use up your hand and keep on drawing!
desc: Call upon the Leader effect of Emporio.Ivankov to draw when you have 0 cards in your hand, and weaponize Counters and hand-discard effects. Draw the 6-cost Monkey.D.Luffy with your 7-cost Emporio.Ivankov to form the ultimate bounce-and-draw duo. Emerge triumphant by playing a constant stream of cards while you never stop drawing.

cards.text: [End of Your Turn] If you have 0 cards in your hand, draw 2 cards.
